findings.summary: The `importRegex` in `findDirectImports` anchors the module name directly to the closing quote, causing it to fail on standard relative imports that include file extensions like `.js`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an optional extension pattern before the closing quote: `(?:\\.(?:js|ts))?` so it matches imports with extensions.

findings.summary: `findDeterministicCallers` uses the literal string regex `/-_/g` instead of a character class, failing to convert kebab-case filenames to camelCase and resulting in searches for invalid identifier names.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the regex to `/[-_](.)/g` and update the replacer to use the first capture group: `targetName.replace(/[-_](.)/g, (_, c) => c.toUpperCase())`.

findings.summary: Attempt 2 and 3 drop the `test` sections that were present in attempt 1 because symbol discovery is trapped inside the `if (attempt === 1)` block, violating progressive expansion.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the `findDeclaration` and `includedSymbols.add` logic outside the `if (attempt === 1)` block so symbols are collected for all attempts, while keeping the `sections.push({ kind: 'symbol' })` inside it.
